The Visual Language of Bakery Intelligence.

BakeIQ unites artisan baking mastery with quantitative algorithmic yield management. Built for commercial bakeries, pastry kitchens, and high-growth food operators requiring real-time batch recipe margin control.

Conceptual Anatomy

The Convergence of Craft & Calculation

Every curve, notch, and node in the BakeIQ mark serves a structural mathematical purpose, representing both the kitchen and the ledger.

Element 01 • Golden Grain

Artisan Heritage

The warm amber left foliole embodies the natural sourdough boule scoring curve and golden malted wheat, grounding the identity in baking craftsmanship.

Element 02 • Costing Ticks

Exact Measurement

Precision micro-notches aligned on the vertical axis signify gram-accurate baker's percentages, portion yields, and ingredient cost allocation.

Element 03 • Ascending Blade

Margin Analytics

The right culinary emerald leaf mirrors a steep upward financial trajectory, reflecting positive gross margin benchmarks and batch yield optimization.

Element 04 • Intelligence Dot

Computational IQ

The luminous apex node atop the growth arc and the angled tail complete the "Q", representing automated pantry alerts and machine intelligence.

Typography & Wordmark Craft

Type System & Data Numerics

Pairing humanistic craftsman curves with tabular financial metrics for seamless inventory formulas and cost sheets.

Wordmark Anatomy: "Bake" + "IQ"

Tracking: -0.025em
Bake Heavyweight Sans IQ Emerald Accent
Bakery Intelligence • Costing
01. Humanist Foundation "Bake" is crafted with heavy humanist geometric cuts, conveying stability, bread density, and physical artisan presence.
02. The Ascending IQ "IQ" is rendered in electric Culinary Emerald to instantly spotlight data computations and technological intelligence.
